name: Forged Steel
summary: Thun'grim Firegaze waits in the eastern Barrens for the steel stolen from his camp. He offers to forge a weapon for the warrior who brings it back.

sections.title: A Blind Spot Exploited
sections.body: Thun'grim Firegaze keeps a smithy in the eastern Barrens, far from Orgrimmar. Years at the forge have dimmed his sight. The nearby Razormane quilboar used that weakness to steal an iron chest from his camp. Some snorted and made noise on one side to draw his gaze while others slipped in from the other and carried off his forged steel bars.

sections.title: Priceless Metal, Clueless Thieves
sections.body: Thun'grim is angry at the theft, but doubts the Razormanes can use the steel. Quilboar craft with stone, tusks, and thorny roots, not refined metal. The heavy chest remains near a broken wagon in their camp, untouched and useless to them. For Thun'grim, its steel is the stock he needs to forge weapons for young Horde warriors.

faq.answer: Thun'grim Firegaze is an orc armorer and weaponsmith in the eastern Barrens. Though his eyesight is failing, he keeps working and arms young Horde warriors.

faq.q: Why did the quilboar steal the steel?
faq.answer: The Razormane quilboar stole the iron chest from Thun'grim's camp in a nighttime diversion. They lack the skill to work the forged steel inside.

faq.q: Where are the forged steel bars kept?
faq.answer: The forged steel bars are locked in the Stolen Iron Chest near a broken wagon in the Razormane grounds northwest of Thun'grim's camp.

faq.q: What weapon does Thun'grim offer in return?
faq.answer: Thun'grim offers young warriors a choice of freshly forged weapons in exchange for recovering his steel.

faq.q: How did the Razormanes manage to trick Thun'grim?
faq.answer: The Razormanes exploited Thun'grim's failing eyesight. Some raiders snorted and made noise to draw his attention while others slipped into his camp and took the chest.

faq.q: Why is Thun'grim living out in the Barrens instead of Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Thun'grim keeps a solitary outpost in the eastern Barrens, where he arms and mentors warriors traveling from Durotar.

angles.text: As a warrior, you recover stolen steel and prove your worth before Thun'grim forges you a weapon.
As a blacksmith, you see why refined steel matters to the Horde in Kalimdor's harsh frontier.
As a member of the Horde, you face Razormane raids on camps and supply lines across the Barrens.
